description: Add several items to an owned Library List in one call, in order (for example a whole packing or to-do list). Give each item its own new itemId UUID and reuse the same values on retries, so a retried call never adds duplicates. Up to 100 items per call; split longer lists. Use the listId and expectedVersion from the latest library_list_get. On library_version_mismatch, read the list again and reconsider the change; never retry blindly. Library Lists only, not trip checklists.

expectedVersion.description: Opaque version from the latest library_list_get or Library List tool result.

itemId.description: New caller-generated UUID for this item; reuse the same value when retrying.

listId.description: Library List ID from library_lists_search or library_list_get.

name: library_list_items_add
title: Add Library List Items
